=========
Changelog
=========

All notable changes to HPC-ScaleTest are documented here.

Version 1.0.0 (2024-01-01)
==========================

Initial Release
---------------

Features
^^^^^^^^

* Automated workflow for HPC scaling tests
* Support for strong and weak scaling
* Multiple scheduler backends (SLURM, PBS, Local)
* Multiple launcher backends (srun, mpirun)
* Module system support (Lmod, Tmod)
* Build system detection (CMake, Make, Autotools, Spack)
* Intelligent input file scaling
* Performance report generation
* YAML configuration support
* Python API
* Command-line interface

Known Issues
^^^^^^^^^^^^

* PBS backend needs more testing
* GPU support limited to NVIDIA

Future Releases
===============

Version 1.1.0 (Planned)
-----------------------

* Enhanced GPU support
* Improved error handling
* Performance optimizations
* Additional examples

Version 2.0.0 (Future)
----------------------

* Web-based dashboard
* Real-time monitoring
* Machine learning-based suggestions
* Cloud platform support
